title: Venezuelan Empanada Cheese Fondue
description: A twist on the classic fondue, incorporating Venezuelan empanadas for an added crunch. Serve with a side of crusty bread.
instructions: Cut empanadas in half and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 5-7 minutes or until crispy.
In a large pot, combine grated cheese and molten.
Place the pot over low heat and stir until the cheese is melted and smooth.
Add the baked empanada halves to the cheese mixture and toss until well coated.
Serve immediately with crusty bread for dipping.
Enjoy your delicious Venezuelan Empanada Cheese Fondue!
